seed: Objects of type `reflection` under action ACTION1 with touching neighbours [wall] show mixed outcomes: no_change x2, x x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a global object such as a counter, HUD element or legend, read as state. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Two-axes mirror game, frame-native: 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks; H/V axes = block row/col with most ring-10 cells.
Selected axis/piece shows 0 centres; A5 cycles H -> V -> pieces (by min block) -> H.
A1/A2 move H (or selected piece) a row, A3/A4 move V (or piece) a col; pieces blocked by edge/other pieces, axes only by edge.
Each piece block mirrors as visible 4 across V, H and both; HUD col 63 turns 11->12 per effective action; stateless.
Hypothesis 'reflection A1 [wall] no_change vs x, global object' = selection state (A1 moves only when H/piece selected), not a counter.
